status: APPROVED by the user 2026-11-15 (batch 2 of the wider chronicle): 15 towns promoted to cities, founding years for all 30 cities, 17 fixed ruins of fallen sects and ruined cities, and the two named parts of the territory history. World Generation & History Core Rule 15; Travel & Map rule 6 (200-300 places). Revised the same day after review: Thảo Đường and Lãng Hoa promoted instead of the vassal-held Thanh Điền and Vọng Hải; Vân Môn Thành lived from 130; the tool writes history_places.json and never edits places.json. 2026-11-15: Thu Phần Các's seat added (minor_seats).
note: Read by tools/design/map/history_places.py, which runs after places.py, sacred.py and history.py. A promoted town keeps its approved name with Thành for Trấn. Ruin tiles were proposed by a scratch search (wild land, at least 5 tiles from any place and 4 from any hidden-slot candidate) and picked by hand. Years are chronicle years; the events behind them are written in batch 4.

ruins.note: Left empty after its master gave the hills to Thúy Vi's founder; quiet and never looted.
Buried by the eruption of Chúc Long Sơn under the ice.
The red-cliff gate Phượng Minh destroyed under Thiên Xu's writ.
The fishers' sect of the frost coast, conquered by Băng Tâm.
The pirates' hold on an islet of the southern gulf.
The mountain fort of the vassal that rebelled against Thiên Xu.
Kim Cốc Viên's merchant city, burned in the crash of 1003.
Cửu Thiều's city, named for the ancient Vân Môn music, twin of the Thiều; abandoned after the War of the Nine Shao.
Khải Lôi's river-mouth city, burned by the lightning of Hầu Xuân Lôi's tribulation.
Lý Hạ: peach petals falling like red rain. Lạc Anh's city on the Petal Shore, burned in the war over its land.

ruins.gloss: City of the Vô Định River
ruins.note: Trần Đào: the bones by the Vô Định river that wives still dream of. Burned in the battle of 803 and left to the miasma.
Lý Bạch: all things since ancient times flow east like water. A mortal town left dry when the river changed its course.
A forest town overrun by a beast tide.
Lý Bạch: the lone sail vanishes into the blue sky. Cô Phàm's harbour, emptied when the fleet was lost.
Vương Xương Linh, the poet of Băng Tâm: the lone fortress looks far toward the jade gate. Destroyed in the Desert Road War.
Lý Thương Ẩn: the pearl in the moonlit sea has tears. Burned by Thôn Hải's raiders.
Lưu Vũ Tích: the thousand-fathom iron chain sank to the river bed. The Tùng Đào and Lạc Hà fort that Thiên Xu broke in the War of the Pivot.

parts.note: grows from Hồng Vũ Thành until it holds every V-1 candidate, then on to its size

minor_seats.note: Lý Hạ: thu phần quỷ xướng Bão gia thi, ghosts sing old poems in the autumn graves. A bamboo hill 10 tiles from the ruins of Lôi Trạch Thành.
